tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List the accounts in your portfolio with their tier and ARR (may include healthy decoys).

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Return facts about one account (tier, ARR, segment, seats, notes).

tools.name: usage_metrics
tools.description: Return product-usage metrics for an account (active seats, weekly active %, feature adoption, trend).

tools.name: health_score
tools.description: Return the account's composite health score (0-100) and its color band. This is a lagging, usage-weighted index.

tools.name: contacts
tools.description: Return the stakeholder map for an account (each contact's role, sentiment, and recent status changes).

tools.name: renewal_calendar
tools.description: Return upcoming renewal dates and current contract terms for an account (or all accounts if none given).

tools.name: similar_accounts
tools.description: Return accounts with a comparable profile to the given one (segment/size peers), with notes on plays that worked for them.

tools.name: log_touch
tools.description: Record an outreach touch (call/email/QBR) with an account contact. Returns a touch id.

tools.name: propose_play
tools.description: Propose a retention/expansion play for an account (e.g. exec-sponsor, expansion, re-onboarding, renewal-incentive).

tools.name: flag_churn_risk
tools.description: Flag an account as a churn risk, recording the account, the driving signal, and your severity (low/medium/high).

tools.name: forecast_renewal
tools.description: Record your renewal forecast for an account: likelihood (0-1) and the expected outcome (renew/expand/downgrade/churn).

tools.name: close_quarter
tools.description: Close out the quarter review with your portfolio assessment. Returns the graded outcome.
